The '''Barpine system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Weneen sector/Legends|Weneen sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barpine]]. The system was also the site of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Barpine Shipyards|shipyard]] which was later used as the base of operations for [[Lon Donell]].
